title: Time-series strategy momentum on v8.1's sleeves (Ehsani-Linnainmaa factor momentum)
rule: for each sleeve s and day d: m = 1.0 if the sleeve's summed daily P&L over days d-90..d-1 is > 0, else 0.5; the sleeve's hourly P&L on day d is multiplied by m BEFORE the usual v8.1 construction (equal risk on trailing vol, Weiss half weight, 30-day vol targeting), so everything stays point-in-time
why: factor momentum: strategies with positive trailing returns keep outperforming; Gen113's continuous Sharpe tilt lost, this is the simpler on/off form from the paper
